analysis:
CHANGELOG.md-only change (head lines ~11-808): release notes for v0.10.6. No executable code, config, or workflow is supplied in this batch, so no concrete security regression can be cited. I read the notes against the threat model for areas needing follow-up in code-bearing units/passes.

(1) The notes say the cluster pair's SSD prompt-prefix records now store quantized attention rows, with a 'balanced' precision default. This touches T-041 and the encrypted SSD tier (A-001, TB-007). The stated posture is unchanged: records are still encrypted, and the changelog says records of one precision are never restored under another. T-041 does not describe the pair tier, the daily write cap persisting across restarts, the shared byte budget, or MiMo prefix storage on both Macs. The threat model likely needs an update to cover the cluster/pair SSD tier. The HMAC lookup, TTL, and account-scoping claims for that tier must be verified in the code diff.

(2) The notes add a large new cluster surface: peer-link encrypted exchanges, rank leases, `native_pair_lease` frames with `resume`, a member control connection to the coordinator, `renew` frames, and cluster_runtime facts in release registration. They also add a login LaunchAgent, an orphan reaper that signals processes, and `cluster cancel-all`. These touch TB-002, TB-003, A-008, A-011, and A-016. The threat model's retained entries contain no specific cluster-pair boundary. I cannot verify authorization of `resume`, peer authentication, PID-reuse guards, or coordinator-side approval derivation (`EIGENINFERENCE_CLUSTER_PAIR_APPROVALS_FROM_RELEASES`) from prose alone.

(3) Release `cluster_runtime` registration flows are gated by repository variables and affect A-011/A-017 trust in builds. The pair-serving grant and public qualification derivation are claimed to be platform-owned, so they are out of scope here.

(4) Environment-variable diagnostics are described as never forwarded to installed ranks. This should be verified in the code.

No findings are raised because the evidence is documentation only. Deeper review of the code units is advisable.
